title: About Me
paragraphs: Hello! I'm Danidu Kavishan, a passionate Computer Science undergraduate with an insatiable curiosity for technology and innovation. My journey in programming began with a simple goal: to harness technology to create meaningful solutions that address real-world challenges.

I started by mastering web development fundamentals with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP, which gave me a solid foundation for building dynamic web applications. This led me to explore desktop application development using the .NET framework, where I learned to build robust, user-friendly desktop solutions.

My passion for accessible technology drove me into mobile app development, where I've gained expertise in Flutter and React Native. I enjoy creating seamless user experiences across different platforms and devices.

Currently, I'm diving deeper into machine learning, Docker containerization, and AI-powered applications. I'm especially interested in how artificial intelligence can transform everyday interactions and solve complex problems. I also use agile methodologies like Scrum to improve collaboration and project efficiency.

When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring the latest tech trends, contributing to open-source projects, or brainstorming innovative solutions with fellow developers. I'm always excited to connect with people who share a passion for technology and innovation.
